text:
emma: Heads-up — dropping a compact onboarding proposal for the 'Orchid' open-family (2B/7B/13B variants). Trying to balance quick customer availability + low ops churn. Pls skim.

emma: Goals: 1) get a vetted 2B into hosted catalog within 2 sprints, 2) provide pin/gracepath for tenants on older 2B forks, 3) autosuggest migration lane with measurable quality/cost deltas.

raj: love the name. quick Q: what's the compatibility shim surface?

emma: shim = small tokenizer mapping + a soft-prompt adapter that we host as a tiny artifact so we don't recompile main weights. Implementation sketch:
```
- tokenizer-map.json (char/regex fixes)
- adapter weights (8-bit) stored as model-variant:orchid-adapter-v1
- serving: fallback path uses adapter if token mismatch rate > 1%
```

maria: adapter path sounds good. how are we benchmarking accuracy? we need both generation and embed parity.

emma: benchmark plan (proposed):
- unit evals: 1k prompt suite from existing onboard set (functional + safety)
- embeddings: 5k QA pairs -> compute recall@10 vs baseline embeddings (target >= 0.95)
- latency/cost: end-to-end p95 token latency <= baseline+10ms, cost delta <= +12% or auto-quantize suggestion applied

devon: what's rollout/pinning policy? customers will ask for longer pins.

emma: proposal:
- default pin TTL = 60 days for new model family; auto-extend to 90d on enterprise contract
- pin-exceptions: opt-in by support with documented migration plan (support ticket + scheduler)
- soft-deprecation: 30d warning + compat-shim for last 90 days of sunset

raj: any canary gating?

emma: yes — two canaries: internal canary traffic (10k reqs across buckets) + 3 customer-staged canaries (opt-in cohort). Gate metrics: regression on quality (automated evals) OR >5% increase in customer-rated hallucination incidents -> block.

maria: how do we measure "customer-rated hallucination incidents" automatically?

emma: we won't auto-derive; we'll use feedback tags + support triage. For the rollout gate we'll look at: automated eval delta, human eval sample (50 cases), and early CS flags.

devon: ops/CPO asks: what infra config? memory footprints + quantization options?

emma: infra notes:
- recommend int8 for 2B/7B on hosted; 13B default int8 + fallback to int4 for Dedicated where throughput required.
- cache sizing: default KV window 2048 tokens; auto-shrink for low-memory hosts.

raj: cost side — can we provide an "upgrade credit" for customers pinned to older variants? helps migration PRs.

emma: planned incentive: 3 months of 25% usage credits if they commit to migration within 45 days of GA and run migration canary. Works as enticement for enterprise.

maria: docs/console UX: need clear "pin status" and migration checklist per tenant. Also an exportable report for sales.

emma: agreed. checklist draft:
- current pin variant + expiry
- automated eval delta vs target
- cost delta estimate / month
- migration steps (test, canary, opt-in)

devon: one edge case: customers with custom adapters on top. how do we support?

emma: we add a "custom adapter compatibility" flag during onboarding. If true -> we route to dedicated lane and require an adapter validation step. Could add a small fee for bespoke validation.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled build pipeline created: pipeline/orchid-onboard/ci triggered. Status: queued.

raj: OK items for next sync:
- engineering: adapter artifact size limit + API for fallback routing (devon)
- research: finalize eval suite and thresholds (maria)
- product: finalize pin TTL & incentive language for comms (emma)
- legal/sales: review credit mechanics (emma -> sales)

emma: thanks — I'll PR the spec doc to /docs/catalog/onboarding and drop the canary playbook draft in this thread by EOD. :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

devon: I'll poke @infra to confirm memory knobs.

raj: +1. if no objections by Friday we cut scope and schedule dev spikes next week.

emma: sounds good — ping me if you need more detail.
